khu-cong-nghiep-song-than-1-binh-duong.title: Song Than 1 Industrial Park, Binh Duong

content.description: Song Than 1 Industrial Park is one of the best-known industrial parks in Binh Duong, offering mature infrastructure, strong logistics access and a fully occupied operating environment.
content.full_content:
Main gate of Song Than 1 Industrial Park
Song Than 1 Industrial Park was established under Decision No. 577/TTg dated September 16, 1995, and its detailed planning was later adjusted by competent authorities in Binh Duong Province.
I. Overview
With total investment capital of VND 245.1 billion, Song Than 1 Industrial Park has a total area of 178.01 hectares, of which 139.71 hectares are leasable industrial land. Located in Binh Duong, the project has attracted both domestic and foreign manufacturers and has become part of the core industrial belt next to Ho Chi Minh City.
Key project data
Name: Song Than 1 Industrial Park
Location: Di An Ward, Di An City, Binh Duong Province
Area: 178.01 hectares
Operating term: 50 years (1995 - 2045)
Occupancy: 100%
Target industries: machinery manufacturing, transport equipment assembly, construction materials, agricultural and forestry processing, garments, electrical and electronics industries.
II. Location and connectivity
The industrial park is located in Di An, Binh Duong, at the gateway to Ho Chi Minh City. It benefits from road, rail and logistics connectivity through National Highway 1A, National Highway 13 and the nearby Song Than railway area.
Approximate distances
Ho Chi Minh City center and Bien Hoa: 16 km
Tan Son Nhat International Airport: 16 km
Saigon Port and Tan Cang: 12 km
Cat Lai Port: 24 km
Vung Tau Port: 100 km
III. Infrastructure
Song Than 1 has a mature infrastructure system designed to support industrial operations.
Internal roads: main roads up to 31 meters wide with branch roads serving factory plots.
Power supply: connected to the national 110 kV grid through a 110 kV - 22 MVA substation.
Water supply: up to 50,000 cubic meters per day.
Wastewater treatment: centralized plant with capacity of 8,400 cubic meters per day.
IV. Operating costs
Infrastructure management and maintenance fee: 0.4 USD per square meter per year.
Electricity tariff: from 0.03 USD/kWh to 0.1 USD/kWh depending on usage period.
Water tariff: 0.4 USD per cubic meter.
Wastewater treatment fee: 0.28 USD per cubic meter.
V. Investment incentives
Enterprises operating in Song Than 1 may access corporate income tax incentives such as full exemption for the first two years and a 50% reduction for the following four years, subject to applicable regulations.
The developer also supports investors with company establishment, branch registration, investment certificates and factory construction procedures.

location.address: Di An Ward, Di An City, Binh Duong Province.
